thread.back.description: The button at the top of a post's screen that goes back to where the reader came from.

thread.label.description: The name of the feed of a post with what it replies to and its replies, for assistive technology.

thread.earlier.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Afficher # publication précédente} other {Afficher # publications précédentes}}
thread.earlier.description: The fold, in a thread, of the posts between its first post and the two the focused post replies to closest; pressing it shows them. count is how many.

thread.replies.description: The heading of the replies under the focused post of a thread.

thread.more_replies.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Afficher # réponse de plus} other {Afficher # réponses de plus}}
thread.more_replies.description: The fold at the end of a thread's replies; pressing it shows more of them. count is how many.

thread.no_replies.description: What a post's screen says under a post that has no replies.

thread.loading.description: What a post's screen says while the post and its thread load.

thread.failed.defaultMessage: La publication n’a pas pu être chargée.
thread.failed.description: What a post's screen, and the list of who reacted to a post, say when the post could not be loaded (the server did not answer, or failed), beside a button to try again.

thread.not_found.defaultMessage: Cette publication est introuvable. Elle a peut-être été supprimée, ou le lien est erroné. Vérifiez le lien ou revenez en arrière.
thread.not_found.description: In place of a post's screen, or of the list of who reacted to it, when the server answers that the post is not there: it never was, was deleted, or the reader may not see it (never say which), under a button back.

thread.retry.description: The button that loads the post again after it failed.

thread.reactors_loading.description: What the list of who reacted to a post with one emoji says while the first of them load.

thread.reactors_failed.defaultMessage: Les réactions n’ont pas pu être chargées.
thread.reactors_failed.description: What the list of who reacted to a post with one emoji says when the first of them could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

thread.reactors_empty.defaultMessage: Personne n’a encore réagi avec cet émoji.
thread.reactors_empty.description: What the list of who reacted to a post with one emoji says when it is empty (the reactions were taken back).

thread.reactors_back.description: The button at the top of the list of who reacted to a post that goes back to the post's own page.
